ننتئي (form VIII)
# نَنْتَئِي (nantaʔī) /nan.ta.ʔiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَأَى (intaʔā)
# نَنْتَئِيَ (nantaʔiya) /nan.ta.ʔi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَأَى (intaʔā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
